'''Grol''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] fighting on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Pratt]] and Sergeant [[Tegan]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when trying to raid the [[House Alde]] estate.
